title: Northwind weekly
transcript:
[00:00:04] Ananya Shah: Morning everyone, how was the long weekend?
[00:00:09] {{USER_NAME}}: Good, thanks. Quiet for once.
[00:03:12] Ananya Shah: On the facility, we are fine with the structure but the prepayment language still worries our credit team.
[00:03:40] {{USER_NAME}}: Understood. I'll turn the term sheet around by Thursday with the prepayment cap we discussed.
[00:04:02] Rohan Mehta: I want to see the cap language before it goes out, so loop me in.
[00:04:15] {{USER_NAME}}: Will do. Rohan, can you confirm with compliance that the cap works for the SAR reporting side?
[00:04:30] Rohan Mehta: Yes, I'll check with compliance and come back to you by Wednesday.
[00:06:10] Ananya Shah: We could consider a step-down fee later, but not for this round.
[00:07:45] Ananya Shah: Can you also send over the revised drawdown schedule?
[00:07:52] {{USER_NAME}}: Sure, I will send the drawdown schedule tomorrow.
[00:08:30] Ananya Shah: Great. Let's reconvene Friday with numbers.
[00:08:36] {{USER_NAME}}: Sounds good, talk Friday.
